description: This file defines a Kotlin class ExpirationDatePickerDialogFragment which is a custom dialog fragment for selecting an expiration date, with branding support and custom UI behavior, used within an Android application.

classes.name: ExpirationDatePickerDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment for selecting an expiration date, with branding customization and callback interface for date selection or unsetting.

methods.name: setOnExpiryDateListener
methods.description: Sets the callback listener for when the expiration date is set or unset.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the DatePickerDialog, setting minimum date, theme, and buttons.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog's buttons based on the provided color.

methods.name: currentSelectionMillis
methods.description: Returns the currently selected date in milliseconds.

methods.name: onDateSet
methods.description: Callback invoked when the user sets a date; forwards the data to the listener.

methods.name: yearMonthDayToMillis
methods.description: Converts a year, month, and day into milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of the dialog with an initial chosen date.
